# Count episodes in January 1995
jan_1995 = df[df['Original air date'].str.contains('January 1995', na=False)]
jan_count = len(jan_1995)

# Count episodes in October 1994
oct_1994 = df[df['Original air date'].str.contains('October 1994', na=False)]
oct_count = len(oct_1994)

# Determine if there were more or less episodes in January 1995 compared to October 1994
if jan_count > oct_count:
    answer = "more"
elif jan_count < oct_count:
    answer = "less"
else:
    answer = "equal"
